title: White Flag Summer
blurb:
After months of hiatus, we are back and ready to share our next issue with you—an issue that explores one of the most complex and delicate periods of a person's life: the summer after high school.
It is an in-between season, a brief interval when life seems to pause, and everything feels both yours and not yours at the same time. I am delighted to introduce the second edition of The Youth Gazette: “White Flag Summer”. This issue is a collection of two contrasting emotions. First, the turmoil of the storm—the chaos of exam season, sleepless nights, uncertainty, and anticipation. Then comes the calm that follows. A surrender. A pause. It is a moment to wave the white flag and simply exist. To feel the warmth of the sun on your face and learn how to appreciate life again.
We hope this issue becomes a preservation of that feeling for you, just as it has become one for us.

title: Tabula Rasa
blurb: The first issue of The Youth Gazette: an intricately curated collection of poetry, prose and beautifully written pieces that tells the story of courage, failure and human emotions. Tabula rasa, a blank slate that gets filled with colours and art when passion and talent come to work together.
